description:
Install any app on Samsung Tizen devices — TVs, projectors and smart monitors

Cross-platform desktop installer that side-loads any app onto Samsung Smart TVs, projectors and smart monitors running Tizen OS — Jellyfin, Moonlight, Moonfin, Litefin and a community catalog, or your own WGT package. Handles device discovery, Tizen certificates and installation. Successor to Jellyfin2Samsung.Jellyfin2Samsung.
📦 v2.7.6 — 2026-08-17
✅ What's New & Improved
- Recreate v2.7.6 binaries — include #551 (macOS/Linux Tizen SDB redownload fix) (#552)
- fix: TizenSdb version parsing bug on macOS and Linux (#551)
- Release v2.7.6 (beta → master) — critical Tizen SDB startup-crash fix (#550)
- chore: update version table in README
- chore: bump version to 2.7.6 (critical Tizen SDB startup-crash fix)
- #547: don't crash startup when Tizen SDB can't be downloaded; guide manual install (#548)
- #541: updater downloaded stable for a detected beta; add a beta-updates toggle (#543)
- mobile: unblock the TV REST API (/api/v2) so TV info fields populate (#542)
- Shared 'TV information' view (DUID, Tizen version, dev mode/IP, …) on both heads (#539)
- docs: live F-Droid repo instructions (README + landing page) (#540)
- Self-hosted F-Droid repo (apps2samsung.com/fdroid/repo), auto-published on stable (#538)
- chore: bump version to 2.7.5 for the next beta cycle
- Show 'restart required' TVs (Dev Mode on, SDB port down) + install-time popup (#536)
- Share the Tizen-version gate in Core + add it to mobile (#537)
- mobile: fix false 'Installed' when the Tizen install actually failed (#535)
